# Typeodd

> A free typing mind game by zendoc. Slow input fades the passage beneath a white veil. Fast correct input grows an almost opaque mark over upcoming letters. Remembering hidden text is the central challenge. A wider mark earns more points; errors cost 30% of the current score.

## Official pages
- [Play](https://typeodd.cording.ai/en/): Solo Classic and anonymous 1:1 matching. Korean and English passages.
- [Rules](https://typeodd.cording.ai/en/how-to-play/): Original marking, decay, veil, input and scoring rules.
- [FAQ](https://typeodd.cording.ai/en/faq/): Answers including 1:1 races and records.
- [About](https://typeodd.cording.ai/en/about/): Original Flutter game, SvelteKit edition and creator.
- [Privacy](https://typeodd.cording.ai/en/privacy/): Solo browser records and anonymous match summaries.
- [Source](https://github.com/zendoclab/typeodd): Historical Flutter source is preserved on the source branch.
- [Works of zendoc](https://me.zendoc.uk/)

Display languages: English /en/, Korean /ko/, Simplified Chinese /zh/, Spanish /es/, Hindi /hi/, Arabic /ar/, French /fr/, Portuguese /pt/, Bengali /bn/, Russian /ru/, Japanese /ja/, German /de/, Indonesian /id/, Urdu /ur/. Arabic and Urdu interfaces use right-to-left layout. Explicit language URLs take priority; unprefixed URLs use a saved preference, then browser language, then English. Display language is independent of the English and Korean passage languages.

Solo finishes at the end of the passage without a countdown. A 1:1 race uses the same passage for both players and a server-confirmed first completion. Races have a 15-minute operational limit. There is no public ranking, account or chat. Solo results stay in the browser; anonymous match summaries expire after seven days. Typeodd does not claim medical effects. This index does not guarantee inclusion in AI search.
